_meanings:
.²1 Ignorance, folly, want of learning. {#avidyAyAmantare vartamAnAH#}
 <ls>Muṇḍ. 1. 2. 8</ls>.
.²2 Spiritual ignorance; <ls>Av. 11. 8. 23</ls>; <ls>Vāj. 40. 12</ls>, <ls n="Vāj. 40.">14</ls>.
.²3 Illusion, illusion personified or Māyā (a term frequently occurring
 in Vedānta; by means of this illusion one perceives the universe, which
 does not really exist, as inherent in Brahman which alone really exists).
 The term appears also in the systems of Gautama, Patañjali, Kapila, where
 it has different bearings; (with Buddhists) ignorance together with non-existence.
